## Activity

During April 2026, Market Eye Clinic recorded 432 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the service. No additional activity measures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 432 captures, 97 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 22.5 per cent. These results identify the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered in the review of the site’s operational performance. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 106 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. Together, the grading results and the image-quality findings provide the reported position for Market Eye Clinic during April 2026. The figures should be read alongside the capture total and the ungradable rate when monitoring activity, image quality and the timeliness of grading.
